questions.text_english:
Read the text given below :

(1) Held every year on 21 May, UNESCO leads the celebration of World Day for Cultural Diversity for Dialogue and Development highlighting not only the richness of the world's cultures, but also the essential role of intercultural dialogue for achieving peace and sustainable development.

(2) A recent international emergency has proved the intrinsic value of the cultural and creative sector at generating social cohesion, educational resource or personal well-being in times of crisis. It has also underscored the sector's potential to generate economic growth, something which is too often underestimated.

(3) With the adoption in September 2015 of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development by the United Nations, and the resolution on Culture and Sustainable Development adopted by the UN General Assembly in December 2015, the message of the World Day for Cultural Diversity for Dialogue and Development is more important than ever. The 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) can best be achieved by drawing upon the creative potential of the world's diverse cultures and engaging in continuous dialogue to ensure that all members of society benefit from sustainable development.

(4) Bridging the gap between cultures is urgent and necessary for peace, stability and development. Cultural diversity is a driving force of development, not only with respect to economic growth, but also as a means of leading a more fulfilling intellectual, emotional, moral and spiritual life. This is captured in the culture conventions, which provide a solid basis for the promotion of cultural diversity. Cultural diversity is thus an asset that is indispensable for poverty reduction and the achievement of sustainable development.

(5) At the same time, acceptance and recognition of cultural diversity in particular through innovative use of media and Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs) are conducive to dialogue among civilizations and cultures, respect and mutual understanding.

(6) In 2001, UNESCO adopted the Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity. Next, in December 2002, the UN General Assembly, in its resolution 57/249, declared May 21 to be the World Day for Cultural Diversity for Dialogue and Development, and in 2015, the Second Committee of the UN General Assembly unanimously adopted the resolution on Culture and Sustainable Development, affirming culture's contribution to the three dimensions of sustainable development, acknowledging further the natural and cultural diversity of the world, and recognizing that cultures and civilizations can contribute to, and are crucial enablers of, sustainable development.

(7) The day provides us with an opportunity to deepen our understanding of the values of cultural diversity and to achieve the goals of the UNESCO Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions adopted on 20 October, 2005.
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer the following questions based on the above passage:
questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

sub_questions.text_english:
Based on the reading and understanding of the above passage, list 2 points to describe the purpose of UNESCO leading the celebration of World Day for Cultural Diversity for Dialogue and Development.
(a) _______
(b) _______

key_points: Highlighting the richness of the world's cultures
Emphasizing the essential role of intercultural dialogue for achieving peace and sustainable development

sub_questions.solution: The purpose of UNESCO leading this celebration is to proudly highlight the immense richness of the world's diverse cultures and to actively emphasize the essential role that intercultural dialogue plays in achieving lasting peace and sustainable development.

sub_questions.text_english:
Select the option that corresponds to the meaning of the following sentence from para (2).
The recent international emergency has proved the intrinsic value of the cultural and creative sector at generating social cohesion, educational resource or personal well-being in times of crisis.

options_english.A: the real worth of cultural sector at generating social cohesion during pandemics
options_english.B: the real worth of creative sector at undermining the social cohesion during an international emergency
options_english.C: questioning the real worth of creative sector at generating education resource during an international emergency
options_english.D: highlighting the real worth of cultural and creative sector at generating social cohesion and educational resource during an international emergency

sub_questions.solution: Option D is correct because it comprehensively covers both the cultural and creative sectors and accurately reflects the positive impact of generating social cohesion and educational resources during a crisis, matching the exact sentiment of the original paragraph.

sub_questions.text_english: Based on your reading of the passage, examine in about 40 words how Sustainable Development Goals can be achieved.

key_points: Drawing upon the creative potential of diverse cultures
Engaging in continuous dialogue

sub_questions.solution: Sustainable Development Goals can be best achieved by strategically drawing upon the immense creative potential of the world's diverse cultures and simultaneously engaging in continuous, meaningful dialogue to ensure that sustainable development effectively benefits all members of global society.

sub_questions.text_english:
What is the tone of the writer in the given line from paragraph (4)? Rationalise your response in about 40 words :
Cultural diversity is an asset.

key_points: Positive / Appreciative / Emphatic tone
Diversity is viewed as a valuable resource for poverty reduction and development

sub_questions.solution: The tone of the writer is highly positive, appreciative, and emphatic. The writer firmly rationalizes that cultural diversity is not a barrier but a highly indispensable resource that acts as a driving force for poverty reduction and achieving sustainable development.

sub_questions.text_english: The phrase 'bridging the gap' in paragraph (4) refers to:

options_english.D: filling in the space between two connected things

sub_questions.solution: Option D is correct because 'bridging the gap' idiomatically means to connect two disconnected or disparate entities or to fill the space between them, thereby creating mutual understanding and peace between different cultures.

sub_questions.text_english:
In sets a-e below, identify two sets of synonyms.
a. richness and poverty
b. intellectual and moral
c. reduction and promotion
d. essential and intrinsic
e. urgent and crucial
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because 'essential' and 'intrinsic' share similar meanings of being fundamentally important, and 'urgent' and 'crucial' both represent something of high critical importance, making them two valid sets of synonyms.

sub_questions.text_english:
Complete the sentence appropriately:
The Second Committee of UN General Assembly in 2015 adopted **

fill_values: the resolution on Culture and Sustainable Development

sub_questions.solution: According to paragraph 6 of the text, the blank is correctly filled to state that the Second Committee of the UN General Assembly in 2015 adopted the resolution on Culture and Sustainable Development.

sub_questions.text_english:
Complete the following sentence:
** is urgent and necessary for peace, stability and development.
sub_questions.solution: Based directly on the first sentence of paragraph 4, bridging the gap between cultures is the exact action described as being urgent and fundamentally necessary for ensuring lasting peace, stability, and holistic development.

questions.text_english:
Read the extract given below :

(1) The National Education Policy 2020 proposes the revision and revamping of all aspects of education, including the educational structure, regulations and governance, to create a new system which is aligned with the aspirational goals of 21st century students. According to the policy, by 2025, at least 50% of learners through the school and higher education system shall have exposure to skill education, for which a clear action plan with targets and timelines are to be developed.

(2) The policy aims to overcome the social status hierarchy associated with skill education and integration of skill education into mainstream education in all educational institutions in a phased manner. Beginning with skill exposure at early ages in middle and secondary school, quality skill education will be integrated smoothly into school and higher education.

(3) Every child will learn at least one skill and is exposed to several more. This would lead to emphasizing the dignity of labour and importance of various vocations involving Indian arts and artisanship.

(4) The development of skill capacities will go hand-in-hand with the development of 'academic' or other capacities. To achieve this objective, secondary schools will have to collaborate with Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), Polytechnics, Local Industry, etc. Skill labs will also be set up and created in the schools in a Hub and Spoke model, which will allow other schools to use the facility. Higher education institutions will offer skill education either on their own or in partnership with industry and other institutions.

The Global Scenario of Students in Skill Education Sector:
India: 5%
Egypt: 30%
Denmark: 50%
USA: 52%
Germany: 75%
South Korea: 96%
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on your understanding of the extract, answer the questions given below:
questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

sub_questions.text_english: Based on the reading of the extract, list 2 objectives of NEP 2020.

key_points: To revise and revamp all aspects of education to align with 21st-century aspirational goals.
To ensure at least 50% of learners have exposure to skill education by 2025.

sub_questions.solution: The National Education Policy 2020 primarily aims to comprehensively revise and revamp the educational structure to align with 21st-century aspirational goals. Additionally, it objectively aims to provide exposure to skill education for at least fifty percent of all learners by the year 2025.

sub_questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank with appropriate option from those given in the brackets, based on the understanding of paragraph (4).
The statement:
The development of skill capacities will go hand-in-hand with the development of academic or other capacities is a / an _______ (fact/opinion) because it is a / an _______ (subjective judgement/objective detail)
sub_questions.solution: The statement expressing that the development of skill capacities will go hand-in-hand with academic development is structurally an opinion because it reflects a forward-looking, subjective judgement and strategic aspiration of the policymakers rather than a currently established scientific fact.

sub_questions.text_english:
Select the option that corresponds to the meaning of the statement given below:
According to the policy, by 2025, at least 50% of learners through the school and higher education system shall have exposure to skill education.

options_english.A: Maximum 50% learners shall have exposure to technical education.
options_english.B: Minimum 50% learners shall have exposure to technical education.
options_english.C: Minimum 50% learners shall have exposure to skill education.
options_english.D: Maximum 50% learners shall have exposure to skill education.

sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the phrase 'at least' mathematically translates to 'minimum'. Furthermore, the passage specifically addresses 'skill education' rather than broadly limiting it to 'technical education'.

sub_questions.text_english:
Based on the understanding of the passage, complete the following statement appropriately:
The benefit of the hub and spoke model will be _______

fill_values: to allow other schools to use the skill lab facilities created in one central school

sub_questions.solution: As explicitly stated in the fourth paragraph of the passage, the primary benefit of the hub and spoke model is that it will allow other surrounding schools to efficiently use the advanced skill lab facilities created centrally within the hub school.

sub_questions.text_english:
Complete the following analogy correctly with a word / phrase from paragraph (3):
Racism : condemn :: _______ : respect
sub_questions.solution: The correct phrase is 'dignity of labour'. Just as racism is universally a concept to logically condemn, the dignity of labour, heavily emphasized in the third paragraph, is a fundamental concept that society must deeply respect and actively promote.

sub_questions.text_english: As per the Global Scenario which country has the maximum percentage of students in Skill Education and what can be the possible reason?

key_points: South Korea has the maximum percentage (96%).
Possible reason includes successful integration of skill education into mainstream education and strong industrial collaboration.

sub_questions.solution: As per the provided Global Scenario data, South Korea proudly leads with the maximum percentage of ninety-six percent of students engaged in Skill Education. A highly possible reason for this overwhelming success is their robust, systemic integration of quality vocational training within mainstream academics and extremely strong, continuous partnerships with diverse local industries.

sub_questions.text_english:
Fill in the following blank choosing the most appropriate option from the ones given below :
As per NEP 2020, skill exposure will begin at _______
sub_questions.solution: Option A is factually correct because paragraph two explicitly states that beginning with skill exposure at early ages in middle and secondary school, quality skill education will be integrated smoothly into the system.

sub_questions.text_english: Justify the statement 'The NEP will create an awareness and appreciation of Indian arts and artisanship.'

key_points: By making every child learn at least one skill.
This exposure emphasizes vocations involving Indian arts, building respect and awareness.

sub_questions.solution: The National Education Policy firmly mandates that every single child will actively learn at least one specific skill. This widespread foundational exposure to various local vocations directly highlights and emphasizes the dignity of labour, thereby intrinsically creating a deep cultural awareness and profound appreciation for rich, traditional Indian arts and native artisanship.

questions.text_english: Complete ANY TEN of the following twelve tasks, as directed:
questions.solution: Grammar tasks set. Complete answers are comprehensively provided within the corresponding sub_questions below.

sub_questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank by using the correct form of the word in the bracket, for the given portion of a letter:
Dear Sir
In response to your query, the document that _______ (explain) our country's sustainability initiatives has been attached for your consideration.
sub_questions.solution: The subject 'the document' is singular, so the verb must also be in the singular present tense to ensure correct subject-verb agreement. Therefore, the corrected word is 'explains'.

sub_questions.text_english:
Read the given sentence. Identify the error and supply the correction in the sentence:
The uniquely flavoured dish was interestingly enough to captivate my taste buds.
sub_questions.solution: The adverb 'interestingly' is used incorrectly here to describe the noun 'dish'. Instead, the correct grammar rule dictates using the adjective 'interesting' before the adverb 'enough'. The corrected sentence is: The uniquely flavoured dish was interesting enough to captivate my taste buds.

sub_questions.text_english:
Raashi and Ratul had a conversation about volunteer work. Report Raashi's question.
Raashi: What challenges have you faced while volunteering?
Ratul: The main challenge is dealing with different personalities, but it's also a great learning experience.

fill_values: Raashi asked Ratul what challenges he had faced while volunteering.

sub_questions.solution: When converting a direct interrogative sentence to reported speech, the present perfect tense 'have faced' must backshift to the past perfect tense 'had faced', and the pronoun 'you' changes to 'he'. The full corrected sentence is: Raashi asked Ratul what challenges he had faced while volunteering.

sub_questions.text_english:
Read the dialogue between a librarian and a student.
Librarian: Welcome back! It's good to see you, young man!
Student: Thanks! I was overloaded with assignments, so I have not visited the library this week.
Based on the conversation above, report the dialogue between a librarian and a student by completing the sentence.
The librarian greeted the student warmly, expressing pleasure at his visit. The student thanked her and explained that _______ which had limited his recent visits to the library.

options_english.A: he had been overloaded with assignments
options_english.B: he has been overloaded with assignments

sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because the rules of reported speech require the past tense verb 'was overloaded' to logically backshift to the past perfect tense 'had been overloaded'.

sub_questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank by choosing the correct option in the bracket, to complete the sentence:
The revised meeting agenda is attached and _______ (this/those/it) needs to be emailed to all participants before the meeting.
sub_questions.solution: The noun 'agenda' functions as a singular, inanimate subject in this context. Therefore, the singular pronoun 'it' is grammatically correct to refer back to it. The full sentence is: The revised meeting agenda is attached and it needs to be emailed to all participants before the meeting.

sub_questions.text_english:
Identify the error and supply correction for the given sentence from an e-commerce website's return policy.
We offers a 30-day return policy on all unopened products purchased from our websites.
sub_questions.solution: The first-person plural subject 'We' strictly requires a plural verb without an 's'. Therefore, the erroneous verb 'offers' must be corrected to 'offer'. The full corrected sentence is: We offer a 30-day return policy on all unopened products purchased from our websites.

sub_questions.text_english:
Select the option that identifies the error and supplies the correction for the sentence from a public health campaign.
The campaign's goal is to increase physical activity among the younger.
sub_questions.solution: Option C correctly identifies the error because 'younger' is a comparative adjective that is incorrectly used as a noun here. The sentence requires a collective noun like 'youth' or 'younger generation' to logically convey the targeted demographic group.

sub_questions.text_english:
Complete the given narrative by filling in the blank with the correct option:
The internship at the tech startup had me _______ excited about the potential of innovation and entrepreneurial spirit.
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because the causative verb structure 'had someone doing something' naturally requires a present participle. Thus, 'feeling' accurately describes the continuous emotional state experienced during the internship.

sub_questions.text_english:
Report the dialogue between a vendor and his customer, by completing the sentence:
Vendor: You look a little different today!
Customer: Yes, I just got a new haircut.
The vendor noticed that his customer's appearance had changed and asked him about it. The customer admitted this, citing the fact that _______

fill_values: he had just got a new haircut

sub_questions.solution: In reported speech, the simple past tense 'got' needs to appropriately backshift into the past perfect tense 'had got' (or 'had gotten'), and the first-person pronoun 'I' changes to the third-person 'he'. The fully corrected completion is: he had just got a new haircut.

sub_questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank by choosing the correct option to complete the sentence to update the result of the regional science fair:
We have exciting news to share! Our school _______ first place in the regional science fair.
sub_questions.solution: Option D is grammatically correct because the sentence is announcing recent news, which perfectly aligns with the present perfect passive voice structure 'has been awarded', indicating an action recently completed with current relevance.

sub_questions.text_english:
Complete the line from a song by filling the blank with the correct option:
The morning dew captures your essence,
The flowers and grass _______ your colour,
The Sunrise embraces your arrival,
As the dawn welcomes a new day.
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because the compound subject 'The flowers and grass' is plural. Therefore, following standard subject-verb agreement rules for the simple present tense context of the poem, the plural verb 'reflect' must be used.

sub_questions.text_english:
Identify the error and supply correction for the given sentence:
The public health campaign aimed in increase awareness of the risks associated with underage drinking.
sub_questions.solution: The verb 'aimed' should logically be followed by the full infinitive form 'to increase' to properly express purpose or intent, rather than the preposition 'in'. The corrected sentence is: The public health campaign aimed to increase awareness of the risks associated with underage drinking.

sub_questions.text_english: (A) There are daily reports in the newspaper of fatal accidents due to reckless driving and road rage. Write a letter to the Commissioner of Traffic Police in about 120 words suggesting the need to take stricter action against the offenders. Recommend the use of social media to launch awareness campaigns about the implications of irresponsible driving. You are Shantanu / Savita, living at B-108 Krishi Apartments.

key_points: Format: Sender address, Date, Receiver address, Subject, Salutation, Sign-off
Highlighting the daily reports of fatal accidents due to reckless driving.
Suggesting stricter actions against offenders.
Recommending the use of social media for widespread awareness campaigns.

sub_questions.solution:
B-108 Krishi Apartments
New Delhi

12 March 2024

The Commissioner of Traffic Police
New Delhi

Subject: Urgent need for stricter action against reckless driving

Sir,
I wish to draw your immediate attention towards the alarming rise in fatal road accidents caused by reckless driving and road rage in our city. Daily newspaper reports consistently highlight tragic losses of innocent lives due to the absolute disregard for vital traffic rules.

It is imperative that the concerned authorities take much stricter action against frequent offenders by imposing heavily punitive fines and promptly cancelling their driving licenses. Furthermore, I strongly recommend launching comprehensive awareness campaigns across various social media platforms to digitally educate the youth about the severe, life-altering implications of irresponsible driving. Prompt action will surely save precious lives and make our roads considerably safer for all daily commuters.

Yours sincerely,
Shantanu

sub_questions.text_english: (B) A leading communication company 'Savera' is sponsoring a half marathon run in your city to raise funds for 'Koshish' an orphanage. You are Roshini/Roshan, school captain of Adarsh Vidyalaya. You are leading a batch of hundred students in the half marathon to be held in your city. Write a letter to the editor of a national daily emphasizing the participation of school children in such programmes as part of voluntary community service. Highlight the benefits of participation in such activities.

key_points: Format: Sender address, Date, Receiver address, Subject, Salutation, Sign-off
Context: Leading 100 students in Savera's half marathon for 'Koshish' orphanage.
Emphasizing children's participation as voluntary community service.
Highlighting physical, moral, and social benefits of such participation.

sub_questions.solution:
Adarsh Vidyalaya
New Delhi

12 March 2024

The Editor
The National Daily
New Delhi

Subject: The crucial role of student participation in voluntary community service

Sir,
Through the columns of your esteemed newspaper, I wish to highlight the immense value of engaging school children in vital community service. Recently, our school is proudly leading a batch of one hundred students in a half marathon sponsored by 'Savera' to benevolently raise funds for 'Koshish', a local orphanage.

Actively participating in such noble programs teaches young students essential values of profound empathy, teamwork, and broad social responsibility. It not only significantly boosts their physical health but also deeply sensitizes them to the genuine struggles of the less fortunate, molding them into highly compassionate future citizens. I earnestly urge all schools to integrate such meaningful voluntary initiatives seamlessly into their regular curriculum to foster holistic character development.

Yours sincerely,
Roshan
School Captain

questions.text_english: Attempt ANY ONE from A and B given below:
questions.solution: Analytical paragraph options. Comprehensive model answers analyzing the given visual data are provided within the specific sub-questions below.

sub_questions.text_english:
(A) The visual given shows the life cycle of a butterfly. Study the information carefully and then summarise it in the form of an analytical paragraph. Make comparisons and draw conclusions wherever applicable.

For visually challenged students only: The following are notes about the four stages in the metamorphosis of butterflies. Summarise the notes in the form of an analytical paragraph:
Eggs -> larva (known as caterpillar) -> pupa (known as chrysalis) -> adult (known as butterfly)

key_points: Clear introduction stating the purpose of the paragraph (life cycle of a butterfly).
Detailed explanation of the four chronological stages: Egg, Larva/Caterpillar, Pupa/Chrysalis, Adult Butterfly.
Logical flow using sequential connectors.
Concluding sentence summarizing the incredible process of metamorphosis.

sub_questions.solution: The provided visual illustration comprehensively depicts the fascinating biological life cycle of a butterfly, capturing the incredible, four-stage process of complete metamorphosis. The complex cycle officially initiates when an adult female firmly lays tiny eggs on a suitable leaf. Subsequently, a ravenous larva, commonly known as a caterpillar, successfully hatches from the egg and rapidly begins feeding on the foliage to sustainably fuel its growth. Once adequately mature, the caterpillar securely attaches itself to a sturdy branch and completely transforms into a hardened, protective pupa, biologically referred to as a chrysalis. Within this highly restrictive shell, remarkable internal changes occur invisibly over time. Finally, a fully formed, magnificent adult butterfly emerges, entirely ready to take flight, boldly mate, and predictably restart the entire perpetual life cycle anew. This dramatic natural transformation vividly highlights nature's incredible adaptability.

sub_questions.text_english:
(B) Study the table given below which shows the data on the hobbies of students during summer vacations. Write an analytical paragraph in about 120 words analyzing what hobbies do boys and girls choose in their summer vacations:

Hobbies | Boys | Girls
Singing | 7% | 25%
Photography | 35% | 5%
Playing | 30% | 16%
Dancing | 13% | 40%
Yoga | 19% | 15%

key_points: Introductory sentence outlining the data presented in the table.
Highlighting the stark contrast in top preferences (Boys prefer photography/playing; Girls prefer dancing/singing).
Noting similarities or balanced activities (e.g., Yoga).
A concluding summarizing thought comparing gender preferences.

sub_questions.solution: The given analytical table clearly illustrates the starkly contrasting preferences in summer vacation hobbies between boys and girls. A highly evident gender divide is immediately noticeable in creative and physical pursuits. The highest preference among boys is notably photography at thirty-five percent, closely followed by active playing at thirty percent. Conversely, an overwhelming forty percent of girls strongly favor dancing, paired with twenty-five percent opting for singing, making performing arts their dominant choice. Interestingly, photography is the least popular among girls at a mere five percent, while singing is similarly unpopular among boys at just seven percent. However, the health-conscious practice of Yoga sees relatively balanced, mutual participation, chosen by nineteen percent of boys and fifteen percent of girls. Conclusively, while boys visibly lean towards outdoor sports and visual arts, girls show a marked inclination towards expressive, rhythmic performing arts.

questions.text_english:
Read the following extracts and answer the questions for ANY ONE of the given two:

(A) On the day of the inauguration, I was overwhelmed with a sense of history. In the first decade of the 20th century a few years after the bitter Anglo-Boer war and before my own birth, the white skinned people of South Africa patched up their differences and created a system of racial domination against the dark-skinned people of their own land. The structure they created formed the basis of one of the harshest, most inhumane societies the world has ever known. Now, in the last decade of the twentienth century, and my own eighth decade as a man, that system has been overturned forever and replaced by one that recognised the rights and freedoms of all peoples, regardless of the colour of their skin.

OR

(B) I started right away at the Montessori Nursery School. I stayed there until I was six, at which time I started in the first form. In the sixth form, my teacher was Mrs. Kuperus, the headmistress. At the end of the year we were both in tears as we said a heartbreaking farewell. In the summer of 1941, Grandma fell ill and had to have an operation, so my birthday passed with little celebration.
questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the two extracts.
questions.solution: Extract-based literature questions. The comprehensive model answers are successfully provided within the specific sub-questions below.
questions.chapter: Nelson Mandela / From the Diary of Anne Frank

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the feelings of the narrator when he said; I was overwhelmed with a sense of history.

key_points: He was flooded with memories of the past.
He remembered the painful history of apartheid and the long struggle to finally overturn it.

sub_questions.solution: Nelson Mandela felt profoundly emotional and deeply nostalgic because he vividly remembered the incredibly painful, long history of racial oppression under apartheid. He recognized the monumental sacrifices made by countless people over the decades to finally witness this historic day of glorious liberation.

sub_questions.text_english: The system of racial domination has been replaced by a system that:

options_english.A: confirms the education of the Blacks.
options_english.B: recognises the rights and freedoms of all people.

sub_questions.solution: Option B is correct because the extract explicitly states at the end that the harsh system of apartheid has been overturned forever and officially replaced by an equitable one that constitutionally recognized the equal rights and fundamental freedoms of all peoples.

sub_questions.text_english: Comment on the kind of society apartheid had created?

key_points: It created a system of extreme racial domination.
It formed the basis of one of the harshest, most inhumane societies known to the world.

sub_questions.solution: Apartheid cruelly established a severely rigid, discriminatory system of absolute racial domination against the native dark-skinned people. Mandela explicitly describes the resulting structure as the fundamental basis of one of the absolute harshest and most deeply inhumane societies the world has ever known.

sub_questions.text_english:
Which phrase would correctly substitute 'patched up' in the given sentence from the extract:
...the white skinned people of South Africa patched up their differences...
sub_questions.solution: In this historical context, the idiom 'patched up' means that they effectively settled, reconciled, or 'resolved' their previous disagreements in order to heavily unite against the native population.

sub_questions.text_english:
In the summer of 1941, Grandma fell ill and had to have an operation, so my birthday passed with little celebration.
State any one inference about Anne from the above context.

key_points: Anne loved her grandmother deeply.
She was understanding and compassionate about not having a big birthday celebration due to her grandmother's illness.

sub_questions.solution: One clear inference is that Anne was deeply attached to her grandmother and was a highly compassionate, understanding child who unselfishly accepted that her own birthday celebration had to be completely sidelined due to her beloved grandmother's serious illness.

sub_questions.text_english: The first education of Anne started at
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the very first sentence of the given extract explicitly and directly states that Anne started her education right away specifically at the 'Montessori Nursery School'.

sub_questions.text_english: Who was Mrs. Kuperus? What kind of relationship did Anne share with her?

key_points: Mrs. Kuperus was the headmistress and her teacher in the sixth form.
They shared a deeply affectionate and emotional bond.

sub_questions.solution: Mrs. Kuperus was simultaneously Anne's teacher in the sixth form and the esteemed headmistress of the school. They proudly shared a deeply affectionate, warm relationship, which is clearly evidenced by their mutual, heartbreakingly emotional tears when they finally bid farewell.

sub_questions.text_english:
Substitute the word 'heartbreaking' with a word similar in meaning in the following sentence:
At the end of the year we were both in tears as we said a heartbreaking farewell.
sub_questions.solution: The adjective 'heartbreaking' conveys deep sadness and profound emotional pain. Therefore, a highly suitable, similar word that accurately fits the emotional context of a difficult farewell is 'sorrowful' or 'devastating'.

questions.text_english:

questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the two extracts.
questions.solution: Extract-based poetry questions. The required comprehensive model answers are securely located within the associated sub_questions below.
questions.chapter: A Tiger in the Zoo / The Ball Poem

sub_questions.text_english: State any one point of contrast between the tiger in the zoo and in its natural habitat.

key_points: In the zoo, the tiger's movement is restricted to a few steps, whereas in the wild, he roams freely through long grass.
